title: WHO GETS CREDIT OR BLAME? ATTRIBUTING ACCOUNTABILITY IN MODERN AI SYSTEMS
findings: The proposed method, AA-Score, successfully identified specific training stages where spurious correlations between religious identity terms (e.g., 'Christian') and toxicity labels were learned. The paper demonstrates that by skipping these identified stages during retraining, the model's reliance on these confounding features can be mitigated.
